blocks.zh: Section 2: Additional Tests & Special Containers | 其他試驗與特殊容器
blocks.en: Section 2: Additional Tests & Special Containers

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握分類系統 Methods 5–8 的完整程序，包括乾燥劑計算公式、控制組設計和分類判定標準
blocks.en: Master the complete procedures of classification Methods 5–8, including the desiccant calculation formula, control group design and classification criteria

blocks.zh: 理解 tight（緊密容器）和 well-closed（良好密閉容器）的 MVTR 分類門檻差異
blocks.en: Understand the difference in MVTR classification thresholds between tight containers and well-closed containers

blocks.zh: 掌握 Method 7（泡殼卡）的四級分類系統（Class A–D）及其判定 MVTR 標準
blocks.en: Master the four-level classification system (Class A–D) of Method 7 (blister cards) and its MVTR criteria

blocks.zh: 理解光譜透過性（Spectral Transmission）測試的設備要求、程序和 Table 3 限度值
blocks.en: Understand the equipment requirements, procedure and Table 3 limits for Spectral Transmission testing

blocks.zh: 熟悉 〈671〉 詞彙表中的關鍵術語定義，並能區分 test specimen 和 test unit 的差異
blocks.en: Become familiar with the definitions of key terms in the <671> glossary, and be able to distinguish a test specimen from a test unit

blocks.zh: Classification System — Introduction 分類系統介紹
blocks.en: Classification System — Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 分類 vs 定量測量
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Classification vs Quantitative Measurement

blocks.zh: 分類系統（Methods 5–8）的目的不同於定量 MVTR 測量（Methods 1–4）：
blocks.en: The purpose of the classification system (Methods 5–8) differs from that of quantitative MVTR measurement (Methods 1–4):

blocks.zh: 定量測量（Methods 1–4）：給出一個精確的 MVTR 數值（如 0.025 mg/day/cavity），用於申報和批間比較
blocks.en: Quantitative measurement (Methods 1–4): gives a precise MVTR value (for example, 0.025 mg/day/cavity), used for filings and lot-to-lot comparison

blocks.zh: 分類系統（Methods 5–8）：只需確認容器是否達到某個等級門檻（如「tight」或「well-closed」），用於重新包裝時選擇容器
blocks.en: Classification system (Methods 5–8): only needs to confirm whether the container meets a grade threshold (for example, "tight" or "well-closed"), and is used to select containers for repackaging

blocks.zh: 重新包裝（Repackaging）：藥局或機構把原廠 100 粒裝分裝成 30 粒小包裝，就是重新包裝。分類系統就是為了確保分裝容器的屏障性能不低於原廠要求。
blocks.en: Repackaging: when a pharmacy or institution divides the manufacturer's 100-count pack into 30-count packs, that is repackaging. The classification system exists to ensure that the barrier performance of the dispensing container is no worse than the original manufacturer requires.

blocks.zh: Primary seal broached（初始密封破壞）：指容器的原始密封（如鋁箔封膜）被打開過。原廠也可用分類方法測試這種情況下的容器性能。
blocks.en: Primary seal broached: the original seal of the container (such as an aluminum foil induction seal) has been opened. The original manufacturer can also use the classification methods to test container performance in this situation.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像買咖啡豆：原廠用氮氣真空袋包裝（定量測量確認屏障性能），你把袋子打開後用自己的密封罐分裝儲存（重新包裝）。
blocks.en: Imagine buying coffee beans: the manufacturer packs them in a nitrogen-flushed vacuum bag (quantitative measurement confirms the barrier performance), and after you open the bag, you transfer the beans into your own airtight jar for storage (repackaging).

blocks.zh: 分類系統就是幫你確認：「你的密封罐夠不夠好？」它不需要告訴你具體能保存幾年，只需要確認「是不是達到緊密容器的等級」——達標了就可以用。
blocks.en: The classification system helps you confirm: "Is your jar good enough?" It does not need to tell you exactly how many years the beans will keep; it only needs to confirm "does it reach the grade of a tight container?" Once it does, you can use it.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 兩種乾燥劑的選用邏輯再確認：
blocks.en: Reconfirming the logic for choosing between the two desiccants:

blocks.zh: Methods 5 & 6 用氯化鈣（多單元瓶裝）→ 與 Method 1 一致
blocks.en: Methods 5 & 6 use calcium chloride (multiple-unit bottles) → consistent with Method 1

blocks.zh: Method 7 用 USP 分子篩 RS（泡殼）→ 與 Method 2 一致
blocks.en: Method 7 uses USP Molecular Sieve RS (blisters) → consistent with Method 2

blocks.zh: 這種對應關係不是偶然：分類方法和定量方法使用相同類型的乾燥劑，確保分類結果與 MVTR 數值之間有可靠的對應關係。
blocks.en: This correspondence is not a coincidence: the classification methods and the quantitative methods use the same type of desiccant, ensuring a reliable correspondence between classification results and MVTR values.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 藥局要分裝原廠標示「密封容器（tight container）」的口服固體藥品，應使用哪個方法來驗證分裝容器的適用性？
blocks.en: A pharmacy wants to repackage an oral solid drug product that the manufacturer labels "tight container". Which method should it use to verify the suitability of the dispensing container?

blocks.zh: Method 6 與 Method 5 的差異是什麼？為什麼 Method 6 的「tight」判定標準（10 mg/day/L）比 Method 5（100 mg/day/L）嚴格 10 倍？
blocks.en: What is the difference between Method 6 and Method 5? Why is the "tight" criterion for Method 6 (10 mg/day/L) 10 times stricter than that of Method 5 (100 mg/day/L)?

blocks.zh: Methods 5, 6, 7 — Procedures & Classification 分類方法程序與判定標準
blocks.en: Methods 5, 6, 7 — Procedures & Classification Criteria

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 10+2 容器設計（控制組邏輯）
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The 10+2 Container Design (Control Group Logic)

blocks.zh: Methods 5 & 6 使用 10 個測試容器 + 2 個對照容器，這是嚴謹的實驗設計：
blocks.en: Methods 5 & 6 use 10 test containers + 2 control containers, which is a rigorous experimental design:

blocks.zh: 測試容器（10個）：填充乾燥劑，測量在 75% RH 環境下吸入的水分
blocks.en: Test containers (10): filled with desiccant, to measure moisture absorbed in the 75% RH environment

blocks.zh: 控制容器（2個）：填充等重的玻璃珠，模擬相同重量但不吸濕。用於修正環境中可能發生的重量漂移（如秤台靜電、空氣浮力等系統性誤差）
blocks.en: Control containers (2): filled with an equal weight of glass beads, simulating the same weight but with no moisture uptake. They are used to correct for weight drift that may occur in the environment (systematic errors such as static on the balance pan and air buoyancy)

blocks.zh:
MVTR 計算公式為：
(1000/14V) × [(T_F − T_I) − (C_F − C_I)]
括號中的 (C_F − C_I) 就是控制組的重量漂移，用於修正系統性誤差。
blocks.en:
The MVTR calculation formula is:
(1000/14V) × [(T_F − T_I) − (C_F − C_I)]
The term (C_F − C_I) in the brackets is the weight drift of the control group, used to correct for systematic error.

blocks.zh: 「30 次開關容器」的操作模擬了真實使用情境。想像一個藥局的藥瓶，顧客或護士每天都要打開取藥——30 次開關讓蓋子的密封性「退化到正常使用狀態」，而不是全新未使用狀態。
blocks.en: The "30 openings and closings" step simulates real-use conditions. Imagine a pharmacy medicine bottle that a customer or nurse opens every day to take out medication: 30 openings and closings let the closure seal "degrade to a normal in-use state" rather than a brand-new, unused state.

blocks.zh: 如果只測試「全新」狀態的密封，測出的屏障性能會過於理想，不代表實際使用中的性能。這就是 30 次開關設計的目的：測真實世界的性能，不是實驗室理想值。
blocks.en: If only the seal in its "brand-new" state were tested, the barrier performance measured would be too ideal and would not represent performance in actual use. This is the purpose of the 30-opening design: to measure real-world performance, not an idealized laboratory value.

blocks.zh: 75% RH 的維持方法：飽和食鹽水（35 g NaCl / 100 mL 水）在密封系統中可維持約 75% RH。這是一個經典的實驗室技巧，不需要精密濕度控制箱，實驗室可以用乾燥器加飽和鹽水來完成。
blocks.en: How to maintain 75% RH: Saturated sodium chloride solution (35 g NaCl / 100 mL water) in a sealed system maintains about 75% RH. This is a classic laboratory technique that does not require a precision humidity chamber; a laboratory can do it with a desiccator and saturated salt solution.

blocks.zh: Method 7 的「指示球（pellet）」：每個空腔放 1 個指示球（pellet，可能是指示型色變乾燥劑），若球變粉紅色或平均重量增加超過 10%，測試終止，只有之前的數據有效。這是一個內建的「過飽和警報機制」。
blocks.en: The "pellet" indicator in Method 7: One indicator pellet is placed in each cavity (possibly a color-changing indicating desiccant). If the pellet turns pink or the average weight gain exceeds 10%, the test is terminated and only the earlier data are valid. This is a built-in "oversaturation alarm".

blocks.zh: Class A–D 的稱量間隔設計：Class D（最差）只需 24 小時就能達到判定終點；Class A（最佳）需要 NLT 28 天。這反映了屏障性能越好，累積到可測量重量變化所需時間越長。
blocks.en: Weighing interval design for Class A–D: Class D (worst) reaches its determination endpoint in only 24 hours, while Class A (best) requires NLT 28 days. This reflects that the better the barrier performance, the longer it takes to accumulate a measurable weight change.

blocks.zh: Method 5 的 MVTR 計算公式中，為什麼分子要乘以 1000？（提示：容積單位為 mL，MVTR 單位為 mg/day/L）
blocks.en: In the Method 5 MVTR calculation formula, why is the numerator multiplied by 1000? (Hint: the volume unit is mL, and the MVTR unit is mg/day/L)

blocks.zh: 若 Method 7 測試中有一包的指示球在第 3 天變粉紅，此測試包的數據應如何處理？
blocks.en: In a Method 7 test, if the indicator pellet in one package turns pink on day 3, how should the data from that test package be handled?

blocks.zh: Classification Criteria — Methods 5, 6, 7, 8 分類判定標準
blocks.en: Classification Criteria — Methods 5, 6, 7, 8

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 — 分類標準速查
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation — Quick Reference of Classification Criteria

blocks.zh:
Method 5（多單元瓶，無感應封）：
  Tight：NMT 1 個 >100 mg/day/L，且無 >200
  Well-closed：NMT 1 個 >2000 mg/day/L，且無 >3000

Method 6（多單元瓶，有感應封）：
  Tight：NMT 1 個 >10 mg/day/L，且無 >25
  （比 Method 5 嚴格 10 倍——因為有膜封）

Method 7（泡殼卡，單位劑量）：
  Class A：所有包裝 ≤ 0.5 mg/day/unit（最佳屏障）
  Class B：所有包裝 ≤ 5 mg/day/unit
  Class C：所有包裝 ≤ 20 mg/day/unit
  Class D：不符合 A、B、C 任一（最差）

Method 8（多單元瓶，液體劑型）：
  Tight：NMT 1 個 >2.5%/year 損失，且無 >5.0%/year
blocks.en:
Method 5 (multiple-unit bottles, no induction seal):
  Tight: NMT 1 container >100 mg/day/L, and none >200
  Well-closed: NMT 1 container >2000 mg/day/L, and none >3000

Method 6 (multiple-unit bottles, with induction seal):
  Tight: NMT 1 container >10 mg/day/L, and none >25
  (10 times stricter than Method 5, because of the film seal)

Method 7 (blister cards, unit-dose):
  Class A: all packages ≤ 0.5 mg/day/unit (best barrier)
  Class B: all packages ≤ 5 mg/day/unit
  Class C: all packages ≤ 20 mg/day/unit
  Class D: does not meet any of A, B, C (worst)

Method 8 (multiple-unit bottles, liquid dosage forms):
  Tight: NMT 1 container >2.5%/year loss, and none >5.0%/year

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — Well-closed vs Tight 的差異
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Well-closed vs Tight

blocks.zh: 這兩個容器類型定義來自 〈659〉，但 〈671〉 提供了具體的 MVTR 數值門檻：
blocks.en: These two container types are defined in <659>, but <671> provides the specific MVTR numerical thresholds:

blocks.zh: Well-closed container（良好密閉容器）：MVTR 門檻為 2000/3000 mg/day/L——屏障要求低，主要防止固體異物進入和液體揮發，不強調水蒸氣屏障。適用於對濕度不敏感的產品。
blocks.en: Well-closed container: MVTR thresholds of 2000/3000 mg/day/L. The barrier requirement is low; the container mainly prevents entry of solid foreign matter and loss of liquid by evaporation, and does not emphasize a water vapor barrier. Suitable for products that are not moisture sensitive.

blocks.zh: Tight container（緊密容器）：MVTR 門檻為 100/200 mg/day/L——屏障要求高 20 倍，用於對濕度敏感的藥品（如泡騰錠、吸濕性較強的固體製劑）。
blocks.en: Tight container: MVTR thresholds of 100/200 mg/day/L. The barrier requirement is 20 times higher, and it is used for moisture-sensitive drug products (such as effervescent tablets and more hygroscopic solid dosage forms).

blocks.zh: 兩個等級相差 20 倍——選錯容器等級，可能導致產品在保存期限內降解！
blocks.en: The two grades differ by a factor of 20. Choosing the wrong container grade may cause the product to degrade within its shelf life!

blocks.zh: Method 7 的 Class A–D 分類就像台灣氣密等級的窗戶分類（WT1 到 WT4）。藥廠在規格書上會標明「需要 Class A 泡殼」，就像建築師指定「需要 WT3 等級的氣密窗」——各方都用同一套等級語言溝通，不需要每次都交換原始 MVTR 數值。
blocks.en: The Class A–D classification of Method 7 is like the airtightness grades for windows in Taiwan (WT1 to WT4). A pharmaceutical company will state "Class A blisters required" in a specification, just as an architect specifies "WT3-grade airtight windows required". Everyone communicates in the same grade language, with no need to exchange the raw MVTR values every time.

blocks.zh: Method 8 與 Methods 5/6 的本質差異：Methods 5/6 測試乾燥劑吸入水蒸氣（針對固體藥品），以 mg/day/L 表示；Method 8 直接測液態水的揮發損失（針對液體藥品），以 %/year（佔初始重量的百分比）表示。
blocks.en: The essential difference between Method 8 and Methods 5/6: Methods 5/6 test the water vapor taken up by a desiccant (for solid drug products) and are expressed in mg/day/L; Method 8 directly measures the evaporative loss of liquid water (for liquid drug products) and is expressed as %/year (percentage of the initial weight).

blocks.zh: Method 8 的測試條件也不同：25°C/40% RH（而非 23°C/75% RH），接近室溫儲存條件，更貼近液體製劑的實際儲存環境。
blocks.en: The test conditions of Method 8 are also different: 25°C/40% RH (rather than 23°C/75% RH), close to room-temperature storage conditions and closer to the actual storage environment of liquid preparations.

blocks.zh: 「2 的判定原則」：Methods 5、6、8 的分類標準都允許「NMT 1 個」超標——不是零容忍。這反映了統計現實：10 個容器中允許 1 個略超邊界值，但有一個絕對上限（無一超過）。
blocks.en: The "NMT 1" acceptance principle: The classification criteria for Methods 5, 6 and 8 all allow "NMT 1 container" to exceed the limit; it is not zero tolerance. This reflects statistical reality: of 10 containers, 1 is allowed to slightly exceed the boundary value, but there is an absolute upper limit (none may exceed it).

blocks.zh: 一批 Method 5 測試結果：10 個容器中，8 個在 50–90 mg/day/L，1 個是 150 mg/day/L，1 個是 180 mg/day/L。這批容器的分類是什麼？（Tight? Well-closed? 不合格?）
blocks.en: A set of Method 5 results: of 10 containers, 8 are at 50–90 mg/day/L, 1 is 150 mg/day/L and 1 is 180 mg/day/L. What is the classification of this set of containers? (Tight? Well-closed? Fail?)

blocks.zh: 一個藥品的說明書標示「密封保存（store in tight container）」，分裝容器通過 Method 5 分類為 well-closed 而非 tight。這樣的分裝是否合規？為什麼？
blocks.en: A product's labeling says "store in tight container", and the dispensing container is classified by Method 5 as well-closed rather than tight. Is such repackaging compliant? Why?

blocks.zh: Spectral Transmission for Light-Resistant Packaging 光阻包裝的光譜透過性測試
blocks.en: Spectral Transmission for Light-Resistant Packaging

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 光阻包裝的測試邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Test Logic for Light-Resistant Packaging

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要光譜透過性測試？許多藥品對光敏感（photolabile），特別是 UV 和可見光範圍的紫外線（290–450 nm）可以分解活性成分、破壞效價或產生毒性降解物。
blocks.en: Why is spectral transmission testing needed? Many drug products are photolabile; in particular, light in the UV and visible range (290–450 nm) can degrade the active ingredient, destroy potency or generate toxic degradation products.

blocks.zh: 「豁免」條件很重要：如果包裝系統通過了穩定性測試（stability testing）並且在穩定性研究中證明藥品不降解，則不需要做光譜透過性測試。換言之，直接的「功能性證明」優先於「物理測試」。這是 ICH Q1B 光穩定性測試的精神——最終目標是確認產品穩定，而非測試包裝材料本身。
blocks.en: The "exemption" condition is important: If the packaging system has passed stability testing and the stability study demonstrates that the drug product does not degrade, spectral transmission testing is not required. In other words, direct "functional proof" takes precedence over "physical testing". This is the spirit of ICH Q1B photostability testing: the ultimate goal is to confirm that the product is stable, not to test the packaging material itself.

blocks.zh: 兩類產品的不同限度：
blocks.en: Different limits for two product types:

blocks.zh: 口服/外用（Oral/Topical）：所有波長下透過率 ≤ 10%（固定標準）
blocks.en: Oral/Topical: transmission ≤ 10% at all wavelengths (a fixed criterion)

blocks.zh: 注射劑（Parenteral）：依容器容量定不同標準（Table 3，1 mL→25%，>50 mL→10%）
blocks.en: Parenteral: different criteria depending on container capacity (Table 3, 1 mL → 25%, >50 mL → 10%)

blocks.zh: 光譜透過性測試就像測試「墨鏡（太陽眼鏡）」的遮光效果。你把鏡片放在光譜分析儀前，測量不同波長的光能透過多少百分比。
blocks.en: Spectral transmission testing is like testing the light-blocking effect of sunglasses. You place the lens in front of a spectrophotometer and measure what percentage of light at different wavelengths passes through.

blocks.zh: 「注射劑小容量→允許較高透過率」的邏輯在於：1 mL 注射劑瓶的壁很薄（玻璃或塑膠壁厚只有 0.5–1 mm），物理上無法像大瓶那樣阻擋更多光線。所以 USP 對小容量注射劑設定了相對寬鬆但仍受管控的限度（25%）。
blocks.en: The logic of "small-volume parenterals → higher transmission allowed" is that the wall of a 1 mL injection vial is very thin (glass or plastic wall thickness of only 0.5–1 mm), so physically it cannot block as much light as a large bottle. USP therefore sets a relatively lenient but still controlled limit (25%) for small-volume parenterals.

blocks.zh: 樣品製備的關鍵細節：
blocks.en: Key details of sample preparation:

blocks.zh: 代表性截面：取「平均厚度」的截面，因為容器壁的厚薄不均會影響透光率
blocks.en: Representative section: take a section of "average thickness", because uneven container wall thickness affects light transmission

blocks.zh: 避免指紋：指紋的油脂會改變表面反射，影響測量準確性——操作時必須戴手套或使用鏡頭紙
blocks.en: Avoid fingerprints: the oil from fingerprints changes surface reflection and affects measurement accuracy; wear gloves or use lens tissue when handling

blocks.zh: 光束垂直入射：圓柱軸平行於分光縫（slit），確保光束垂直照射截面，最小化反射損失（Fresnel reflection），讓測量值真實代表材料本身的透光性
blocks.en: Perpendicular incidence of the beam: the cylinder axis is parallel to the slit, ensuring the beam strikes the section perpendicularly, minimizing reflection loss (Fresnel reflection), so that the measured value truly represents the light transmission of the material itself

blocks.zh: 290–450 nm 範圍的意義：290 nm 是玻璃/塑膠開始透光的短波邊界（低於此波長幾乎被材料完全吸收）；450 nm 是可見光藍紫色邊界。這個範圍涵蓋了對大多數光敏藥品最危險的波段。
blocks.en: Significance of the 290–450 nm range: 290 nm is the short-wavelength boundary at which glass/plastic begins to transmit light (below this wavelength it is almost completely absorbed by the material); 450 nm is the boundary of blue-violet visible light. This range covers the wavelengths most hazardous to most light-sensitive drug products.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，客戶可能要求評估新供應商的琥珀色（amber）注射劑玻璃瓶或棕色 PET 塑膠瓶是否符合光阻要求。光譜透過性測試流程：
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, a client may ask you to evaluate whether a new supplier's amber glass injection vials or brown PET plastic bottles meet light-resistance requirements. The spectral transmission testing workflow:

blocks.zh: 從瓶身側壁切取具有代表性厚度的截面（避開瓶底和瓶頸）
blocks.en: Cut a section of representative thickness from the side wall of the bottle (avoiding the base and the neck)

blocks.zh: UV-Vis 分光光度計掃描 290–450 nm，以空氣為參比
blocks.en: Scan 290–450 nm on a UV-Vis spectrophotometer, using air as the reference

blocks.zh: 對照 Table 3 的容量限度（或口服/外用的 10% 統一限度）
blocks.en: Compare against the capacity limits in Table 3 (or the uniform 10% limit for oral/topical)

blocks.zh: 若超標，可考慮加外包裝（opaque secondary packaging，豁免主容器測試）
blocks.en: If the limit is exceeded, consider adding outer packaging (opaque secondary packaging, which exempts the primary container from testing)

blocks.zh: 一個 5 mL 注射劑瓶在 320 nm 處測得透過率為 18%，是否符合 Table 3 的要求？
blocks.en: A 5 mL injection vial has a measured transmission of 18% at 320 nm. Does it meet the requirements of Table 3?

blocks.zh: 如果一個清澈透明的塑膠眼藥水瓶（外用，5 mL）外面套了一個不透光的紙盒，這個眼藥水瓶需要做光譜透過性測試嗎？請說明理由。
blocks.en: If a clear, transparent plastic eye-drop bottle (topical, 5 mL) is placed in an opaque paper carton, does this eye-drop bottle need spectral transmission testing? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: Glossary 詞彙表
blocks.en: Glossary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — Test Specimen vs Test Unit 的差別
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Test Specimen vs Test Unit

blocks.zh: 這兩個術語在文件中頻繁出現，必須清楚區分：
blocks.en: These two terms appear frequently in the document and must be clearly distinguished:

blocks.zh: Test specimen（測試樣品）：最基本的包裝單元。瓶裝→一個瓶子就是一個 specimen。泡殼→一張含多個空腔的泡殼卡是一個 specimen。
blocks.en: Test specimen: the most basic packaging unit. For bottles, one bottle is one specimen. For blisters, one blister card containing multiple cavities is one specimen.

blocks.zh: Test unit（測試單元）：進行稱重操作的最小分組。瓶裝→test unit = test specimen（一樣）。泡殼→test unit = 多張卡捆在一起（為了獲得足夠的重量增加）。
blocks.en: Test unit: the smallest grouping on which weighing is performed. For bottles, test unit = test specimen (the same). For blisters, test unit = several cards bundled together (to obtain sufficient weight gain).

blocks.zh: 簡言之：specimen 是材料定義；unit 是操作定義。對於泡殼，unit ≥ specimen。
blocks.en: In short: the specimen is a material definition; the unit is an operational definition. For blisters, unit ≥ specimen.

blocks.zh: Test specimen 就像一個「受測者」，test unit 就像一個「測試小組」。體重秤的精度有限時，你可以把 5 個受測者組成一組一起稱，再除以 5 取平均。這樣的「小組稱重」就是 test unit 的概念——把多個 specimens 捆在一起，讓微小的重量變化累積到可偵測的程度。
blocks.en: A test specimen is like a "subject", and a test unit is like a "test group". When a scale has limited precision, you can weigh 5 subjects together as one group and then divide by 5 to get the average. This "group weighing" is the concept of the test unit: bundling multiple specimens together so that tiny weight changes accumulate to a detectable level.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 章節交叉參考總結
blocks.en: Key Notes — Chapter Cross-Reference Summary

blocks.zh: 〈671〉 與其他 USP 章節的關係圖：
blocks.en: Relationship between <671> and other USP chapters:

blocks.zh: 〈659〉 Packaging and Storage Requirements：定義容器類型術語（well-closed, tight, hermetic, light-resistant 等）→ 〈671〉 提供測試方法驗證這些類型
blocks.en: <659> Packaging and Storage Requirements: defines container type terms (well-closed, tight, hermetic, light-resistant, etc.) → <671> provides the test methods to verify these types

blocks.zh: 〈857〉 UV-Vis Spectrophotometry：光譜透過性測試（〈671〉）使用的分光光度計需符合 〈857〉 要求
blocks.en: <857> UV-Vis Spectrophotometry: the spectrophotometer used for spectral transmission testing (<671>) must meet the requirements of <857>

blocks.zh: 〈1671〉 MVTR Application：如何用 〈671〉 的 MVTR 數據支持重新包裝等值性論證 → 進階應用指導
blocks.en: <1671> MVTR Application: how to use the MVTR data from <671> to support repackaging equivalence justifications → advanced application guidance

blocks.zh: ICH Q1B 光穩定性測試：若已通過光穩定性測試，可豁免光譜透過性測試（〈671〉 明確允許）
blocks.en: ICH Q1B photostability testing: if photostability testing has been passed, spectral transmission testing may be waived (explicitly permitted by <671>)

blocks.zh: 一種新型的聚氯乙烯（PVC）改性泡殼材料，測試 MVTR 為 0.08 mg/cavity/day（40°C/75% RH）。它屬於哪個屏障等級？應使用哪個方法進行後續分類測試？
blocks.en: A new modified polyvinyl chloride (PVC) blister material has a tested MVTR of 0.08 mg/cavity/day (40°C/75% RH). Which barrier grade does it fall into? Which method should be used for subsequent classification testing?

blocks.zh: 藥廠申報書件中要描述「本產品使用 tight container 包裝」，如何用 〈671〉 的測試數據支持這個聲明？需要用哪個方法，達到什麼標準？
blocks.en: A regulatory submission needs to state that "this product is packaged in a tight container". How can the <671> test data be used to support this claim? Which method is needed, and what criterion must be met?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 屏障等級三分法
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Three Barrier Grades

blocks.zh: 〈671〉 詞彙表明確定義了三個屏障等級，以 40°C/75% RH 條件下的 MVTR 為界：
blocks.en: The <671> glossary clearly defines three barrier grades, with boundaries based on MVTR under 40°C/75% RH conditions:

blocks.zh: 這三個等級正好對應三個數量級的差異（1.0 vs 0.01），選錯材料的後果差距 100 倍！
blocks.en: These three grades correspond to differences of orders of magnitude (1.0 vs 0.01), so the consequence of choosing the wrong material can differ by a factor of 100!

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 分類系統（Methods 5–8）用於藥局和機構重新包裝者選擇容器，目標是確認等級（tight/well-closed/Class A–D），而非獲取精確 MVTR 數值
blocks.en: The classification system (Methods 5–8) is used by pharmacies and institutional repackagers to select containers; the goal is to confirm the grade (tight/well-closed/Class A–D) rather than to obtain a precise MVTR value

blocks.zh: Tight 和 well-closed 的 MVTR 門檻差 20 倍（100 vs 2000 mg/day/L）；Method 6（有感應封）的限度比 Method 5 嚴格 10 倍
blocks.en: The MVTR thresholds for tight and well-closed differ by a factor of 20 (100 vs 2000 mg/day/L); the limit for Method 6 (with induction seal) is 10 times stricter than for Method 5

blocks.zh: 光譜透過性測試範圍為 290–450 nm；口服/外用容器均勻限度為 10%；注射劑依容積有 10–25% 的分級限度（Table 3）；若已通過光穩定性測試可豁免
blocks.en: The spectral transmission test range is 290–450 nm; the uniform limit for oral/topical containers is 10%; for parenterals there are graded limits of 10–25% by capacity (Table 3); testing may be waived if photostability testing has been passed

blocks.zh: 三個屏障等級：Low-barrier（>1.0 mg/day/cavity）→ Method 3；High-barrier（<1.0）和 Ultra-high barrier（<0.01）→ Method 2
blocks.en: Three barrier grades: Low-barrier (>1.0 mg/day/cavity) → Method 3; High-barrier (<1.0) and Ultra-high barrier (<0.01) → Method 2

blocks.zh: Test specimen（基本包裝單元）≠ Test unit（操作稱量分組）；泡殼測試中多張卡捆成一個 test unit 以累積足夠重量變化
blocks.en: Test specimen (basic packaging unit) ≠ Test unit (operational weighing group); in blister testing, several cards are bundled into one test unit to accumulate sufficient weight change
